modifications: Converted from TEI XML to plain text paragraphs with emphasis, with the long s printed as s. Each exposition opens with the verse it expounds, such as Verse 5. I will therefore put you in remembrance, and is one section, keyed by the verse the transcription numbers it with, so the exposition of verses 22 and 23 is one section, and the exposition of verse 24, whose label is misprinted Verse 94., is keyed to verse 24. A verse named in the exposition is never read. Every gap the transcribers could not key is kept as the mark they gave it, such as • for an illegible letter and 〈◊〉 for an illegible word. Line-end hyphens are closed up. Left out: the title page, the dedication to Lady Letitia Popham, the epistle to the reader, the alphabetical table, the table of the places of Scripture explained, and the errata.
